messages.studio.nav.privateDescription: Stored on this computer. No account or cloud required.
messages.studio.dashboard.heroTitle: Create documentation you'll be proud to share.
messages.studio.dashboard.heroDescription: Write, organize, and design documentation locally. Your files always belong to you.
messages.studio.dashboard.continue: Continue working or start something new.
messages.studio.dashboard.createFirst: Create your first project to start writing and organizing documentation.
messages.studio.dashboard.noCloud: Paglora works without a cloud account.
messages.studio.settings.title: Settings
messages.studio.settings.description: Everything is stored locally. No login or cloud service required.
messages.studio.settings.appearanceDescription: Choose a light or dark theme, or follow your system preference. Your choice is saved on this computer.
messages.studio.settings.storageDescription: Paglora saves projects in the selected local folder. You can move them here.
messages.studio.settings.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app only
messages.studio.settings.storageFuture: Custom storage locations and portable .paglora backups are available.
messages.studio.settings.aboutDescription: Open-source local-first documentation studio · MIT License
messages.studio.settings.languageDescription: Changes the Studio interface on this computer. Website language is configured separately in Design site.
messages.studio.settings.languagePartial: Partial translations fall back to English for missing entries.
messages.studio.projects.createDescription: Projects are saved locally and can be edited anytime.
messages.studio.projects.browserOnly: Browser preview only. Launch the Tauri desktop app to use local projects.
messages.studio.projects.desktopRequired: Run Paglora Desktop to create local projects.
messages.studio.pages.createDescription: Add a Markdown page to your documentation.
messages.studio.pages.renameDescription: The page identifier stays the same, so its links remain stable.
messages.studio.pages.deleteDescription: The page will be removed from navigation. Its Markdown file will remain in the project's local .trash folder.
messages.studio.pages.dragHint: Hold the grip to drag a page, or use Move up / Move down in its menu.
messages.studio.editor.saveError: Couldn't save: {message}. Check disk permissions before leaving.
messages.studio.design.dialogDescription: Customize the real published header, navigation, and footer. Preview updates instantly; save to keep your changes.
messages.studio.design.colorModeHelp: Separate from the Paglora desktop appearance. Applies to real static exports.
messages.studio.design.paletteHelp: Palettes coordinate backgrounds, text, borders and code blocks in both light and dark mode. Your custom accent stays independent.
messages.studio.design.cardStackedDetail: One card per row; preserves existing sites
messages.studio.design.cardHelp: Place two or more Card blocks next to each other. The grid automatically fits the available article width and collapses to one column on narrow screens.
messages.studio.design.documentLanguageHelp: Sets the exported HTML language for accessibility and search engines. Does not translate your content.
messages.studio.design.fontHelp: Leave empty for Geist. Enter a Google Fonts family to load it from Google's servers on the published website. Visitors need an internet connection to fetch it; Geist remains the fallback. Your site's CSS can override the font.
messages.studio.design.accentHelp: Buttons, links, active navigation, and selected states use your accent color. Custom project CSS can still override these values.
messages.studio.design.siteUrlHelp: Full HTTPS root ending in /, including the GitHub Pages repository path. When set, export includes canonical URLs and a public-only sitemap.xml. Leave empty for offline or unknown hosting.
messages.studio.design.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MiB. Local assets are bundled into public exports; you can also use their assets/ URL in Markdown images.
messages.studio.design.imageLimit: Local images must be between 1 byte and 5 MiB.
messages.studio.design.articleWidthHelp: Controls the maximum width of the documentation article.
messages.studio.design.noLinks: No links yet. You can add up to eight.
messages.studio.design.linkHelp: Use HTTPS URLs, mailto: links, or an existing public page filename such as getting-started.html.
messages.studio.design.rendererHelp: The same renderer produces the website you export.
messages.studio.backup.invalid: Choose a .paglora file smaller than 96 MiB.
messages.studio.backup.description: Portable project backups include pages, design settings, CSS and images. Backups stay on your computer.
messages.studio.updater.description: A newer stable release is available. Review the changes before installing.
messages.studio.updater.noNotes: See GitHub Releases for the complete changelog.
messages.studio.updater.stableDescription: Only signed, versioned releases are installed. Nightly builds are excluded.
messages.studio.updater.upToDate: You're using the latest stable Studio release.
messages.studio.updater.onlyInstalled: Update checks are available in installed Studio builds.
messages.studio.release.title: What's New · Studio v{version}
messages.studio.release.description: Release notes are also available offline and on GitHub.
messages.studio.release.empty: No notes are bundled for this version.
messages.studio.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
messages.studio.shortcuts.description: Customize Studio commands. Reserved keys and conflicts are detected automatically.
messages.studio.shortcuts.newProjectDesc: Open the workspace project creation dialog
messages.studio.shortcuts.local: Shortcuts are stored on this computer, not in .paglora projects.
messages.studio.shortcuts.badKey: Press Ctrl/Cmd with a letter, number or comma. Esc cancels.
messages.studio.shortcuts.invalid: Use Ctrl/Cmd with a letter, number or comma. Common system shortcuts are reserved.
messages.studio.shortcuts.saveError: Could not save shortcut preferences on this computer.
messages.studio.shortcuts.reserved: Browser and editor formatting shortcuts are reserved. Duplicate shortcuts are not allowed.
messages.studio.storage.offlineReason: The configured drive could not be opened.
messages.studio.storage.offlineHelp: Paglora did not create an empty replacement workspace. Reconnect the drive or choose another existing copy below.
messages.studio.storage.recoveryHelp: Only an existing, valid, non-empty Paglora workspace is accepted. Files are never overwritten; the previous configured path is preserved for recovery.
messages.studio.storage.new: Move projects to a new folder
messages.studio.storage.migrationHelp: Enter an absolute path for a new folder that does not exist yet (its parent must exist). Paglora copies and verifies files before switching storage. Originals remain in the previous folder, and backups stay in app data.
messages.studio.storage.migratedDetail: All source files were verified. Originals were preserved for recovery.
messages.studio.storage.reconnectedDetail: Projects are available at the selected location.
messages.studio.storage.returnTitle: Safely return to the previous drive
messages.studio.storage.returnDescription: Paglora will copy your CURRENT projects into a new verified folder beside {path}, then switch the active location. Your old folder and your current files remain untouched. This will not overwrite stale backups.
messages.studio.storage.returnedDetail: The latest files were verified in a new folder; the old copies remain untouched.
messages.studio.storage.returnError: Unable to return to previous drive
